OFFERING CIRCULAR

Corvid Bioworks, Inc.
Up to 4,166,666 Shares of Class A Common Stock
Minimum investment: 100 shares ($480)
Price to public: $4.80 per share
Maximum offering: $20,000,000

Dated April 14, 2026

This Offering Circular relates to the offer and sale of up to 4,166,666 shares of Class A common stock of Corvid Bioworks, Inc., a Delaware corporation, at $4.80 per share, for a maximum of $20,000,000, pursuant to Regulation A under the Securities Act of 1933 (Tier 2). The offering is being made on a "best efforts" basis by the Company directly and through Larkspur Securities LLC, a broker-dealer registered with the Commission and a member of FINRA and SIPC, which will receive a commission of 5% of the gross proceeds.

THE UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION DOES NOT PASS UPON THE MERITS OF OR GIVE ITS APPROVAL TO ANY SECURITIES OFFERED OR THE TERMS OF THE OFFERING, NOR DOES IT PASS UPON THE ACCURACY OR COMPLETENESS OF ANY OFFERING CIRCULAR OR OTHER SOLICITATION MATERIALS. THESE SECURITIES ARE OFFERED PURSUANT TO AN EXEMPTION FROM REGISTRATION WITH THE COMMISSION; HOWEVER, THE COMMISSION HAS NOT MADE AN INDEPENDENT DETERMINATION THAT THE SECURITIES OFFERED ARE EXEMPT FROM REGISTRATION.

Generally, no sale may be made to you in this offering if the aggregate purchase price you pay is more than 10% of the greater of your annual income or net worth. Different rules apply to accredited investors and entities. Before making any representation that your investment does not exceed applicable thresholds, we encourage you to review Rule 251(d)(2)(i)(C) of Regulation A. For general information on investing, we encourage you to refer to www.investor.gov.

This offering will terminate at the earlier of the date on which the maximum offering amount is sold, one year from the date this offering statement is qualified by the Commission, or the date the Company elects to terminate it.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

Risk Factors; Dilution; Plan of Distribution; Use of Proceeds; Description of Business; Description of Property; Management's Discussion and Analysis; Directors, Executive Officers and Significant Employees; Compensation of Directors and Officers; Security Ownership of Management and Certain Securityholders; Interest of Management and Others in Certain Transactions; Securities Being Offered; Financial Statements.

USE OF PROCEEDS

If the maximum offering is sold, the Company will receive net proceeds of approximately $18,600,000 after the 5% commission and estimated offering expenses of $400,000. The Company intends to apply approximately $9,000,000 to clinical validation of its assay pipeline, $5,000,000 to laboratory capacity, $2,500,000 to working capital, and the balance to general corporate purposes. If only 50% of the maximum is sold, the Company will apply the proceeds first to clinical validation and laboratory capacity in the same proportions and will defer the remainder. There is no minimum offering amount and no escrow; proceeds are available to the Company as subscriptions are accepted, and an investor who subscribes early bears the risk that the offering does not raise enough to accomplish its objectives.

DILUTION

Purchasers in this offering will suffer immediate dilution. The Company's net tangible book value as of December 31, 2025 was $0.71 per share. After giving effect to the maximum offering, pro forma net tangible book value would be approximately $2.14 per share, so a purchaser at $4.80 would suffer immediate dilution of $2.66 per share, or 55%. Existing holders acquired their shares at a weighted average price of $0.34 per share.

ONGOING REPORTING

As a Tier 2 issuer the Company will file an annual report on Form 1-K within 120 days of its fiscal year end, a semiannual report on Form 1-SA within 90 days of the end of its first fiscal half, and current reports on Form 1-U on the events Rule 257(b)(4) specifies. The Company's obligation to file continues until it is terminated under Rule 257(d).

TRANSFERABILITY

The shares are not subject to a Rule 144 holding period, but there is no public market for them and none is expected to develop. An investor should be prepared to hold the shares indefinitely.

FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

The Company's financial statements for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2025 have been audited by Harborview Assurance LLP, an independent registered public accounting firm, and are included beginning on page F-1.
